milestone: Native shared-weight vector4 FP16/F32 RMSNorm execution
status: Qualified standalone normalization operator; whole inference/vLLM goal remains active

implementation.api: BnGPUVector4RMSNormResidentPlan and rmsnorm_vector4_f16_f32_resident; CUDA SM80+ callback. Reads immutable model-owned raw F16/BF16 gamma, or unweighted NULL.
implementation.arithmetic: Original vector4 sequential FMA sum, XOR warp/block reduction, FTZ arithmetic, approximate divide/rsqrt, FP16 input clamp. Weighted result multiplies x by gamma+bias before inverse-rms*scale. PTX forms preserve upstream compiler contraction choices without changing global compiler flags.
implementation.ownership: Only input/output activation views are request-owned. Gamma remains shared in model backend resources. Validate owner, type, exact extent, groups, alignment and lifetime generation before enqueue. Device failure poisons request.
implementation.views: n_tokens counts flattened rows. Gamma group is row modulo weight_groups. dim positive multiple4; FP16/F32 input/output. Exact same-type alias supported; partial overlap rejected. Finite constants and positive epsilon required.
implementation.execution: No setup workspace/reserve, allocation, host copy or synchronization in execution. No residual/span-head mode; existing BF16 norm paths unchanged.
implementation.license: Adapted from MIT exllamav3 norm.cu at bd1f519172406a9560bd5c90e61000691bb69a07; notice/LICENSE retained under third_party/exllamav3.

validation.reference: Unchanged original RES_NONE kernel, helpers and vector types extracted, original launch geometry replayed with upstream --use_fast_math. Includes original compiled-kernel FP16 clamp and BF16/F16 weight loads; not Torch mathematical approximation or native-generated expected values.
validation.synthetic: 120 frozen source-kernel fixtures, digest checks cover9924768 output words across two requests/alias runs; direct byte comparisons also include these cases in the actual probe. Dimensions4/32/128/1280/5120, F16/BF16/unweighted gamma, all F16/F32 I/O pairs, zero/tiny/large/half Inf+NaN inputs, bias/scale variants, guards and rejected plans.
validation.chunking: Group-aligned split execution equals whole-row reference; exact in-place execution also matches. These are operator checks, not resumed whole-model inference.
validation.sanitizers: Clang18 address/undefined sanitizer host+actual0; CUDA memcheck0errors0leaks; initcheck0errors; racecheck0hazards/errors/warnings.

profile.scope: Warmed root/output RMSNorm, F32 input/output, shared model-owned BF16 gamma, M256 D5120,64 calls. Model preparation and request allocation outside capture.

kernels.name: void bn_cuda_native_norm::kernel<float, float, __nv_bfloat16>(const T1 *, T2 *, const T3 *, int, int, int, float, float, float)

profile.limitations: One warmed operator shape; no full-layer/model throughput or vLLM parity claim. Context/module/library/driver memory is separate.

prior_attempts: Initial original-kernel capture omitted upstream --use_fast_math; retained under strict-reference and not used as the target. Recompiled/captured with original fast flags before production implementation.

Initial native fixture97 affine FP16->F32 mismatch: explicit .rn qualifiers on add/mul introduced a rounding barrier absent from upstream PTX. Removed those qualifiers (kept FTZ/approx op forms); all2888 original fast-kernel cases then matched in separate prototype before final clean rebuild. Initial build/test logs retained.
Initial test C header misleading-indentation warning corrected before final clean build.
